description: This file defines a command handler class for creating account transfers within the Fineract project. It handles the 'CREATE' action for 'ACCOUNTTRANSFER' commands by invoking the appropriate service method.

classes.name: CreateAccountTransferCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service that handles account transfer creation commands by invoking the account transfer write service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to create an account transfer, delegating to the write platform service.
